items.html: And we shall begin to explain the order of their correction. That upper head that is not known (Reisha deLo Iyada), called Atik Yomin, is the first of all the aforementioned ten Sefirot, called original and fundamental for all of Atzilut. However, in this head there is no grip at all, and we cannot expand in it the speech and explanation required for it. But know that it is included of the ten Sefirot within it, which are KHB HGT NHY.
